about: Key matching: whole words (Latin and Cyrillic), case sensitivity, regex keys, secondary logic, per-entry scan depth, speaker names in the scan text. Every entry has preventRecursion, so only direct matches fire.

messages.text: *Mira looks up from the logbook.* You came through that weather? Sit down and dry off.
I tie the boat to the anchor ring outside.
Good. The old ferry rope rots in this weather.
Мирный вечер, правда? Маяк горит. I set the kettle by the lamppost.
